entities.name: Aleksander Gintowt-Dziewałtowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aleksander Kazimierz Gintowt-Dziewałtowski was a Roman Catholic archbishop of the Archdiocese of Mohilev from 1883 to his death in 1889. He previously served as auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Płock and titular bishop of Helenopolis from 1872 to 1883.
